This '''Kloperian guard''' was part of a group of 50 [[Kloperian]]s working on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to upgrade the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[New Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|starfighters]]. The Kloperians were installing [[Bomb/Legends|detonators]] in the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] on behalf of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Kueller]]. This guard, along with a couple of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] found [[Cole Fardreamer]] inside a prototype [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]]. Fardreamer had discovered a detonator, however, the Kloperian guard accused him of having planted it himself. The Kloperian, armed with three [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], shot at [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] accompanying Fardreamer, when the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] jacked into a [[computer terminal]], summoning [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]. Antilles arrived soon after and dismissed the Kloperian guard. The guard later went to the office of [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] to complain of the treatment it had received.<ref name="TNR" />
